reviewItem.question: For "`service_name` label: Loki 3.0 will automatically assign a `service_name` label to all ingested logs by default", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0 now automatically assigns a service_name label to all ingested logs by default, discovered from a list of labels configurable via limits_config.discover_service_name (empty value disables it).
